reading_correction: Nothing in the reading. The predecessor listed both SKILL.md doors as conformers, and the build-out never touched them — correctly. Akien, 2026-08-07, on the UNTOUCHED red: 'well that's it's job. to take a note about something that will become an intention.' The capture door conforms BY standing — its promise is prose in, byte-identical — and the gate's one question ('have the bytes moved off the baseline?') cannot measure conformance-by-standing, so a door listed as a conformer is a permanent red no act could clear: the noise ruling.py itself names. The build-out's byte-movers were the two charters (how_it_learns now names each door's armed reader), baselined here at the commit standing when he ruled (cairn 35736b4, before the day's work). The probes and tickets the build-out CREATED cannot sit in what_conforms at all — 'a ruling cannot conform a file that did not exist when it was ruled' (fingerprint_at) — so the charters, which name them, carry the conformance for the set.
context: A standing ORDER doctrine, not a one-shot: when work competes, the mind's own layer comes first, then the skills/workflow it fires, then the gates and inspectors that support those, then everything queued toward librarian. THE BOUND OF TIER 1, ruled 2026-08-07 on CC's clarifying question and renamed by Akien to 'fix or extend claude': settings; CLAUDE.md; cleaning memory files; superclaude, rescueclaude, and any future specialized launchers; evaluating new skills from the web; the shim; running tests to compare model behavior; and making it possible to inject compact commands or otherwise change how the system or Akien interacts with CC. The tier includes capabilities NOT YET BUILT (compact injection is one) — tier 1 is extension, not only repair. The immediate application LANDED 2026-08-07: /idea and /design each carry an armed watch (WATCHME(idea-capture-pickup), WATCHME(design-return-trip)), tickets an-idea-has-an-address and the-return-trip-is-countable, both boats at PROVED — cairn 1e6de92, CairnCommons 374097a.
